basic_info.description: Charming Marina-style home in Central Sunset, just steps from Irving Street's vibrant shops and restaurants, half a block to the N-Judah MUNI line, two blocks from Golden Gate Park, and minutes from UCSF, Botanical Garden, Academy of Science, Stow Lake, and other iconic destinations. This timeless home boasts a spacious west-facing barrel-front living room with an original fireplace, a formal dining room, a kitchen with an eat-in area, a good-sized covered side patio, a full bath, a quarter bath, and two side by side spacious bedrooms in the back overlooking large backyard. An interior stairway off the main hall leads to additional unwarranted rooms, a full bath, and a wet bar on the ground floor, complete with a separate side entrance. The property also offers one-car garage parking, and an additional driveway parking space. The home features fresh interior and exterior paint, as well as new flooring throughout the top floor over the existing hardwood. This is a perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience!
